comment: Measured inputs for the C3 3 nm-class projection of the A1 tensor tile (a1_mma_tile). Same RTL and flow settings on both predictive kits; both at the typical corner, 0.7 V. Run folders are on the aimem-eda volume (Extreme Pro).

flops_per_cycle.comment: one MMA per cycle (rotating accumulators, C2): 64 BF16, 128 FP8 or 256 FP4 multiply-adds; 2 FLOP per multiply-add

asap7.stage: fully routed, 0 DRC; equivalence proved (post-repair and final)
asap7.fmax_source: OpenSTA at TT (RVT TT NLDM) on 6_final.odb + 6_final.spef; the run itself used the BC corner (196.7 MHz)
asap7.power_source: same TT STA, report_power, OpenSTA default switching activity

gt2n.kit: GT2N (predictive 2 nm nanosheet GAA, backside power, ISCAS 2026)
gt2n.stage: through global routing only: detailed routing needs more than the 39 GB Docker VM (peaked 38.6 GB); post-repair equivalence proved
gt2n.fmax_source: 5_1_grt.json timing__fmax (global-route parasitic estimate, TT 0.7 V 25 C); post-CTS was 399.7 MHz

target.name: IRDS 2023 "3nm+" logic node
target.source: IRDS 2023 More Moore, Table MM-7 (Device Architecture and Ground Rules Roadmap), 2023 column: G48M24, M0 pitch 24 nm, gate pitch 48 nm
